summary: Saransk International Airport (SKX/UWPS) serves the capital of the Republic of Mordovia in southwestern Russia. The airport underwent a major modernization ahead of the 2018 FIFA World Cup, during which Saransk was one of the host cities, resulting in a new terminal and upgraded runway facilities. It provides regional connections primarily to Moscow and Saint Petersburg, as well as seasonal charter flights.
faqs:
Q: How far is the airport from Saransk city center?
A: The airport is located approximately 7 km southwest of central Saransk, typically a 15-20 minute drive depending on traffic.

Q: Which airlines operate from Saransk International Airport?
A: The airport is primarily served by Russian carriers including Aeroflot, S7 Airlines, and IrAero, offering regular flights to Moscow and other major Russian cities.

Q: Does the airport have international flights?
A: International services are limited and mostly seasonal, though the airport has the infrastructure to handle international flights as established during the 2018 FIFA World Cup.

Q: Are there facilities for passengers with overnight layovers?
A: Limited overnight amenities are available; most travelers arrange accommodations in the city or the nearby hotels along the approach road.
transport_tips: Public marshrutka (fixed-route minibus) and taxi services connect the airport to central Saransk, with journey times around 20 minutes. Official airport taxis and ride-hailing apps such as Yandex Go are reliable options and can be pre-booked online. During winter months, allow extra time as road conditions on the approach can be affected by snow.
local_tip: Visit the Mordovian Erzia Art Museum in Saransk before or after your flight to see the world's second-largest collection of works by the renowned sculptor Stepan Erzia, a cultural highlight unique to this region.
